key: NOEL: This must be the top of the trunk.
en: NOEL: This must be the top of the trunk.
ja: ノエル: ここが幹の頂上のはずです。

key: NOEL: It would look better with color, I guess.
en: NOEL: It would look better with color, I guess.
ja: ノエル: 色があれば、もっと見栄えがするのでしょうね。

key: Too bad.
en: Too bad.
ja: 残念だったね

key: Whatever caused this should be near here.
en: Whatever caused this should be near here.
ja: これを引き起こしている原因は、この近くにあるはずです。

key: NOEL: It's probably another Anomaly.
en: NOEL: It's probably another Anomaly.
ja: ノエル: おそらく、また別のアノマリーです。

key: NOEL: There's some kind of barrier in the way?
en: NOEL: There's some kind of barrier in the way?
ja: ノエル: 何かバリアのようなものが、行く手を阻んでいますね?

key: I see.
en: I see.
ja: なるほど。

key: Maybe if Eve had been the one to get up here instead, she could've done something.
en: Maybe if Eve had been the one to get up here instead, she could've done something.
ja: 私の代わりにイヴがここに来ていたら、何かできたかもしれません。

key: NOEL: Was that--
en: NOEL: Was that--
ja: ノエル: 今のは――

key: HEATHER: COMING THROUGH!!!
en: HEATHER: COMING THROUGH!!!
ja: ヘザー: 通るわよ!!!

key: HEATHER: GRRRRRR!!!
en: HEATHER: GRRRRRR!!!
ja: ヘザー: グルルルル!!!

key: Now that stupid thing is just going to heal up again!
en: Now that stupid thing is just going to heal up again!
ja: これでまた、あのバカな奴、回復しちゃうじゃない!

key: I'm getting REALLY sick of all these STUPID barriers!
en: I'm getting REALLY sick of all these STUPID barriers!
ja: このバカみたいなバリア、マジでもうウンザリなんだけど!

key: HEATHER: That Yveltal is eating the color right out from the forest!
en: HEATHER: That Yveltal is eating the color right out from the forest!
ja: ヘザー: あのイベルタル、森から色を食い尽くしてるのよ!

key: And its roost is right up here, and it keeps going back there to recover and I can't GET to it because more and more of these STUPID walls keep appearing!
en: And its roost is right up here, and it keeps going back there to recover and I can't GET to it because more and more of these STUPID walls keep appearing!
ja: そいつのねぐらがちょうどこの上にあって、回復するたびそこに戻っちゃうんだけど、こんなバカみたいな壁がどんどん現れて、たどり着けないのよ!

key: It was hard enough to find a way in the first time, and now the exits keep sealing!
en: It was hard enough to find a way in the first time, and now the exits keep sealing!
ja: そもそも入り口を見つけるだけでも大変だったのに、今度は出口まで塞がっていくし!

key: HEATHER: ...And THAT keeps happening!
en: HEATHER: ...And THAT keeps happening!
ja: ヘザー: ……しかも、あれがずっと起き続けてるし!

key: I don't even know what's causing that, but I don't think we want to stay to find out!
en: I don't even know what's causing that, but I don't think we want to stay to find out!
ja: あれの原因なんて全然分かんないけど、それを確かめるためにここに残りたいとは思わないわね!

key: Salamence is tired and the barrier is closing in-- let me get you guys out of here!
en: Salamence is tired and the barrier is closing in-- let me get you guys out of here!
ja: ボーマンダも疲れてるし、バリアも迫ってきてる――あんたたちをここから連れ出してあげる!

key: NOEL: ...No, that's okay.
en: NOEL: ...No, that's okay.
ja: ノエル: ……いえ、大丈夫です。

key: HEATHER: What?! What do you mean "That's okay"?!
en: HEATHER: What?! What do you mean "That's okay"?!
ja: ヘザー: は!? 「大丈夫」ってどういうこと!?

key: NOEL: I'll stay.
en: NOEL: I'll stay.
ja: ノエル: 私は残ります。

key: If I find out what it is, at least I can be useful.
en: If I find out what it is, at least I can be useful.
ja: 何なのか突き止められれば、少なくとも役に立てますから。

key: HEATHER: You won't be useful if it knocks you out!
en: HEATHER: You won't be useful if it knocks you out!
ja: ヘザー: 気絶させられたら、役になんて立たないでしょ!

key: NOEL: I can take the risk.
en: NOEL: I can take the risk.
ja: ノエル: そのリスクは引き受けます。

key: HEATHER: What--
en: HEATHER: What--
ja: ヘザー: は――

key: UGGGH, everything is SO annoying!
en: UGGGH, everything is SO annoying!
ja: うわあああ、もう全部イライラするんだけど!

key: Fine, take a dirt nap for all I care!
en: Fine, take a dirt nap for all I care!
ja: はいはい、勝手に土のベッドで昼寝でもしてれば!

key: \PN, I'm at least getting YOU out of here so you can figure out what's up with this barrier and FIX IT!
en: \PN, I'm at least getting YOU out of here so you can figure out what's up with this barrier and FIX IT!
ja: \PN、あんたは連れ出すからね、このバリアが何なのか突き止めて、直してよ!

key: Hang on tight-- it's take-off time!
en: Hang on tight-- it's take-off time!
ja: しっかりつかまって――離陸するわよ!

key: NOEL: Yveltal is the reason that the color went away.
en: NOEL: Yveltal is the reason that the color went away.
ja: ノエル: イベルタルが、色が失われた原因です。

key: But it didn't mean to eat it.
en: But it didn't mean to eat it.
ja: でも、色を食べようとしたわけではありません。

key: It couldn't help it.
en: It couldn't help it.
ja: そうせざるを得なかったのです。

key: It was just trying to exist in the world it was put in.
en: It was just trying to exist in the world it was put in.
ja: ただ、置かれた世界の中で存在しようとしていただけです。

key: NOEL: So you dealt with Yveltal too.
en: NOEL: So you dealt with Yveltal too.
ja: ノエル: では、イベルタルにも対処したのですね。

key: But it still looks like this.
en: But it still looks like this.
ja: それでも、まだこの状態のままです。

key: I guess there's no reason that removing the source of the problem would undo it.
en: I guess there's no reason that removing the source of the problem would undo it.
ja: 問題の原因を取り除いたからといって、元に戻る理由があるわけではないのでしょう。

key: Disappointing.
en: Disappointing.
ja: 残念です。

key: NOEL: It's nice to look at colors I decided should be there.
en: NOEL: It's nice to look at colors I decided should be there.
ja: ノエル: 自分がそこにあるべきだと決めた色を眺めるのは、いいものですね。

key: But there's more I can do.
en: But there's more I can do.
ja: でも、私にできることは、まだあります。

key: Give me some time.
en: Give me some time.
ja: 少し時間をください。

key: I'll take you to Anna.
en: I'll take you to Anna.
ja: アンナのところに連れていきます。

key: I'll take you to Lin.
en: I'll take you to Lin.
ja: リンのところに連れていきます。

key: I just need a little bit of a lead...
en: I just need a little bit of a lead...
ja: 少し手がかりが必要なだけです……

key: NOEL: I know how we can get to Anna.
en: NOEL: I know how we can get to Anna.
ja: ノエル: アンナのところへ行く方法が分かりました。

key: NOEL: I know how we can get to Lin.
en: NOEL: I know how we can get to Lin.
ja: ノエル: リンのところへ行く方法が分かりました。

key: Well, it's more like I can put you at her,
en: Well, it's more like I can put you at her,
ja: というより、正確には、あなたを彼女の場所に送り込める、という感じですが、

key: I think.
en: I think.
ja: おそらく。

key: There are two things I need though.
en: There are two things I need though.
ja: ただ、必要なものが二つあります。

key: One: I need you to remove the meteor.
en: One: I need you to remove the meteor.
ja: 一つ目: メテオを取り除いてもらう必要があります。

key: The big one, that is.
en: The big one, that is.
ja: つまり、あの大きいものです。

key: There's too much of her on it. It's blocking my vision.
en: There's too much of her on it. It's blocking my vision.
ja: あれには、彼女のものがあまりに多くついていて、視界を塞いでいます。

key: Giratina can do it for you.
en: Giratina can do it for you.
ja: ギラティナが、あなたのためにそれをやってくれるはずです。

key: Two: I need someone who has seen where she is.
en: Two: I need someone who has seen where she is.
ja: 二つ目: 彼女がいる場所を見たことがある人が必要です。

key: That person is Fern.
en: That person is Fern.
ja: その人物は、ファーンです。

key: ...Sorry.
en: ...Sorry.
ja: ……すみません。

key: Fern is the only other person besides Anna who's been to where she is.
en: Fern is the only other person besides Anna who's been to where she is.
ja: ファーンは、アンナ以外で唯一、彼女のいる場所に行ったことがある人物です。

key: He was there before, and lost to Lin.
en: He was there before, and lost to Lin.
ja: 彼は以前そこにいて、リンに負けました。

key: Fern is the only other person besides Lin who's been to where she is.
en: Fern is the only other person besides Lin who's been to where she is.
ja: ファーンは、リン以外で唯一、彼女のいる場所に行ったことがある人物です。

key: He was there before, and lost.
en: He was there before, and lost.
ja: 彼は以前そこにいて、負けました。

key: When I say "before," I don't mean, for example, an hour ago.
en: When I say "before," I don't mean, for example, an hour ago.
ja: 「以前」といっても、たとえば一時間前、というような意味ではありません。

key: I mean, for example, a clock ago.
en: I mean, for example, a clock ago.
ja: たとえば、一つの時計前、というような意味です。

key: I'm starting to see what Anna meant.
en: I'm starting to see what Anna meant.
ja: アンナが言いたかったことが、少し分かってきました。

key: What she saw, and how hard it is to talk about so it makes sense.
en: What she saw, and how hard it is to talk about so it makes sense.
ja: 彼女が見たもの、そしてそれを筋道立てて語ることがどれほど難しいか、ということです。

key: I see that he turned to stone.
en: I see that he turned to stone.
ja: 彼が石になっているのが見えます。

key: We have to fix that too.
en: We have to fix that too.
ja: それも直さなければなりません。

key: Bring Giratina to the Meteor, and bring Fern here.
en: Bring Giratina to the Meteor, and bring Fern here.
ja: ギラティナをメテオに連れていき、ファーンをここに連れてきてください。

key: Those were the New World entrances at Beryl Cave, and Tanzan Depths.
en: Those were the New World entrances at Beryl Cave, and Tanzan Depths.
ja: それらは、ベリルどうくつとタンザン深部にある、ニューワールドの入り口でした。

key: Then I can put you at Anna.
en: Then I can put you at Anna.
ja: そうすれば、あなたをアンナの場所に送り込めます。

key: Then I can put you at Lin.
en: Then I can put you at Lin.
ja: そうすれば、あなたをリンの場所に送り込めます。

key: NOEL: I see.
en: NOEL: I see.
ja: ノエル: なるほど。

key: Okay, we can begin.
en: Okay, we can begin.
ja: では、始められます。

key: FERN: So what exactly are we doing here?
en: FERN: So what exactly are we doing here?
ja: ファーン: それで、オレたちここで一体何やるんだ?

key: Can you actually tell me now that \PN's here?
en: Can you actually tell me now that \PN's here?
ja: \PNが来た今なら、本当のこと教えてくれんのか?

key: NOEL: You don't need to do anything.
en: NOEL: You don't need to do anything.
ja: ノエル: あなたは何もする必要はありません。

key: Just wait. I'll make a door.
en: Just wait. I'll make a door.
ja: 待っているだけでいいです。私が扉を作りますから。

key: FERN: What do you mean by "a door"?
en: FERN: What do you mean by "a door"?
ja: ファーン: 「扉」って、どういう意味だよ?

key: Why am I here?
en: Why am I here?
ja: なんでオレがここにいるんだよ?

key: NOEL: You just needed to be there.
en: NOEL: You just needed to be there.
ja: ノエル: あなたは、そこにいるだけでよかったのです。

key: You were at the place that \PN is going.
en: You were at the place that \PN is going.
ja: \PNがこれから向かう場所に、あなたはいたことがあります。

key: FERN: I was?
en: FERN: I was?
ja: ファーン: オレが?

key: Where??
en: Where??
ja: どこにだよ??

key: When????
en: When????
ja: いつのことだ????

key: I'm not following you here.
en: I'm not following you here.
ja: 話について行けてないぞ。

key: NOEL: It was about a clock ago.
en: NOEL: It was about a clock ago.
ja: ノエル: 一つの時計ほど前のことです。

key: NOEL: Just be quiet for a moment so I can focus on it.
en: NOEL: Just be quiet for a moment so I can focus on it.
ja: ノエル: 少し静かにしていてください、集中したいので。

key: Got it.
en: Got it.
ja: 分かりました。

key: NOEL: That door will put you at Anna.
en: NOEL: That door will put you at Anna.
ja: ノエル: あの扉が、あなたをアンナのところへ送ります。

key: FERN: ...Who?
en: FERN: ...Who?
ja: ファーン: ……誰だよ?

key: NOEL: My sister.
en: NOEL: My sister.
ja: ノエル: 僕の姉です。

key: FERN: Something wrong with her?
en: FERN: Something wrong with her?
ja: ファーン: 彼女に何かあったのか?

key: NOEL: She's Dreamsick.
en: NOEL: She's Dreamsick.
ja: ノエル: 姉はドリームシックです。

key: FERN: I don't think I've heard of that...
en: FERN: I don't think I've heard of that...
ja: ファーン: 聞いたことないな、それ……

key: NOEL: By its nature.
en: NOEL: By its nature.
ja: ノエル: その性質上、当然でしょうね。

key: Mom was the same way, I guess.
en: Mom was the same way, I guess.
ja: 母も、同じだったんだと思います。

key: They changed the world so hard they fell out of it.
en: They changed the world so hard they fell out of it.
ja: 世界をあまりにも強く変えすぎて、そこからこぼれ落ちてしまったんです。

key: And then they were forgotten by everyone but those closest to them,
en: And then they were forgotten by everyone but those closest to them,
ja: そして、一番近しい人たち以外の全員から、忘れられてしまう、

key: Like characters in a dream that felt so real just a minute ago.
en: Like characters in a dream that felt so real just a minute ago.
ja: ついさっきまで、すごくリアルに感じていた夢の中の登場人物みたいに。

key: FERN: But she's still there.
en: FERN: But she's still there.
ja: ファーン: でも、彼女はまだそこにいるんだろ。

key: NOEL: A little bit.
en: NOEL: A little bit.
ja: ノエル: 少しだけ、ですけどね。

key: She still thinks she's fighting Lin.
en: She still thinks she's fighting Lin.
ja: 姉はまだ、リンと戦ってると思い込んでるんです。

key: She fought Lin for so long she doesn't know how not to anymore.
en: She fought Lin for so long she doesn't know how not to anymore.
ja: あまりにも長くリンと戦い続けてきたせいで、戦わない方法が分からなくなってしまった。

key: And in a way she is.
en: And in a way she is.
ja: それに、ある意味では、実際そうなんです。

key: Being so close to Arceus is poisoning her.
en: Being so close to Arceus is poisoning her.
ja: アルセウスにあれほど近づいていることが、姉をむしばんでいます。

key: But she can't leave.
en: But she can't leave.
ja: でも、離れることができない。

key: We have to save her from herself.
en: We have to save her from herself.
ja: 姉を、姉自身から救わないといけないんです。

key: FERN: ...All right, I'm on board.
en: FERN: ...All right, I'm on board.
ja: ファーン: ……分かった、乗った。

key: What do we do?
en: What do we do?
ja: 何をすればいい?

key: Round everyone up for the rescue mission of the century?
en: Round everyone up for the rescue mission of the century?
ja: 世紀の救出作戦のために、みんなを集めるのか?

key: NOEL: That door will put you at Lin.
en: NOEL: That door will put you at Lin.
ja: ノエル: あの扉が、あなたをリンのところへ送ります。

key: FERN: Shit, it's finally time, huh?
en: FERN: Shit, it's finally time, huh?
ja: ファーン: くそ、ついに来たか。

key: Should we round up the other leaders, get ready to storm in there and put her out for good?
en: Should we round up the other leaders, get ready to storm in there and put her out for good?
ja: 他のリーダーたちも集めて、乗り込んで、あいつを完全に片付ける準備をした方がいいか?

key: NOEL: No.
en: NOEL: No.
ja: ノエル: いいえ。

key: Only \PN needs to go.
en: Only \PN needs to go.
ja: 行く必要があるのは、\PNだけです。

key: FERN: What?
en: FERN: What?
ja: ファーン: は?

key: C'mon, you called me all the way up here and expect me to not ride into battle too?
en: C'mon, you called me all the way up here and expect me to not ride into battle too?
ja: おいおい、わざわざここまで呼んどいて、オレを戦いに参加させないつもりか?

key: NOEL: Yes. I just needed your past self's memories.
en: NOEL: Yes. I just needed your past self's memories.
ja: ノエル: そうです。必要だったのは、過去のあなた自身の記憶だけなので。

key: FERN: ... That's kinda uncool, but fine.
en: FERN: ... That's kinda uncool, but fine.
ja: ファーン: ……なんかカッコ悪いけど、まあいい。

key: I'm not about to get my breeches twisted over it.
en: I'm not about to get my breeches twisted over it.
ja: そんなことでいちいちかんしゃく起こしたりしないさ。

key: Just tell me why you're sending \PN to do it alone.
en: Just tell me why you're sending \PN to do it alone.
ja: ただ、なんで\PNを一人で行かせるのか、それだけ教えてくれ。

key: I know I may not be the best guy for the job, but isn't some backup better than none?
en: I know I may not be the best guy for the job, but isn't some backup better than none?
ja: オレがこの仕事に一番向いてる奴じゃないのは分かってるけど、援護は無いよりあった方がいいだろ?

key: The less noise, the better.
en: The less noise, the better.
ja: 騒ぎは少ない方がいいんです。

key: The harder she thinks she has to try, the more likely she is to disappear for good.
en: The harder she thinks she has to try, the more likely she is to disappear for good.
ja: 頑張らなきゃと思うほど、姉が完全に消えてしまう可能性が高くなるんです。

key: I won't risk that.
en: I won't risk that.
ja: そのリスクは冒せません。

key: She's expecting everyone.
en: She's expecting everyone.
ja: 姉は、みんなが来ると予想しています。

key: She has something ready for everyone.
en: She has something ready for everyone.
ja: みんなのために、何か用意しているんです。

key: That amount of resistance will only enable her.
en: That amount of resistance will only enable her.
ja: それだけの抵抗があれば、姉をかえって助長させるだけです。

key: If only \PN goes, she'll wilt under her own expectations.
en: If only \PN goes, she'll wilt under her own expectations.
ja: \PNだけが行けば、姉は自分自身の期待の重さに耐えられなくなるはずです。

key: FERN: ...I don't like it, but I think I get it.
en: FERN: ...I don't like it, but I think I get it.
ja: ファーン: ……気に入らないが、分かった気がする。

key: Fine.
en: Fine.
ja: いいだろう。

key: \PN, just know that I'm on deck if something goes wrong.
en: \PN, just know that I'm on deck if something goes wrong.
ja: \PN、何かまずいことになったら、オレが控えてるからな。

key: I can heal your team if you need to.
en: I can heal your team if you need to.
ja: 必要なら、チームを回復させてやるよ。

key: NOEL: Good luck.
en: NOEL: Good luck.
ja: ノエル: 幸運を。

key: We're counting on you.
en: We're counting on you.
ja: あなたを頼りにしています。

key: NOEL: Bring Fern here.
en: NOEL: Bring Fern here.
ja: ノエル: ファーンをここに連れてきてください。

key: I can see him at the door from Tanzan.
en: I can see him at the door from Tanzan.
ja: タンザンからの扉のところに、彼がいるのが見えます。

key: NOEL: Bring Giratina to the Meteor.
en: NOEL: Bring Giratina to the Meteor.
ja: ノエル: ギラティナをメテオに連れていってください。

key: The one from the cave near here.
en: The one from the cave near here.
ja: この近くの洞窟にいたものです。

key: NOEL: Bring Giratina to the Meteor, and bring Fern here.
en: NOEL: Bring Giratina to the Meteor, and bring Fern here.
ja: ノエル: ギラティナをメテオに連れていき、ファーンをここに連れてきてください。

key: NOEL: Pulling her out of that world likely will not cure her Dreamsickness.
en: NOEL: Pulling her out of that world likely will not cure her Dreamsickness.
ja: ノエル: あの世界から姉を引っ張り出しても、おそらくドリームシックは治りません。

key: But she needs to be separated from Arceus.
en: But she needs to be separated from Arceus.
ja: でも、アルセウスから引き離す必要はあります。

key: This is as bad as it is because of Lin's secondhand influence.
en: This is as bad as it is because of Lin's secondhand influence.
ja: ここまでひどくなっているのは、リンの間接的な影響のせいです。

key: Be gentle with her.
en: Be gentle with her.
ja: 優しく接してあげてください。

key: NOEL: Back at Sigmund's, I never expected this to go this far.
en: NOEL: Back at Sigmund's, I never expected this to go this far.
ja: ノエル: ジグムントのところにいた頃は、こんなことになるなんて思ってもいませんでした。

key: She and Anna were just playing simple chess.
en: She and Anna were just playing simple chess.

en: NOEL: I know what happens to others, but it's not me.

key: I was in control even in the aura.
en: I was in control even in the aura.
ja: オーラの中でも、僕は自分を制御できていました。

ja: でも、そんなことはどうでもいいです。

key: Let's be done.
en: Let's be done.
ja: 終わらせましょう。

key: I'm tired of others assuming they know what I need better than I do.
en: I'm tired of others assuming they know what I need better than I do.
ja: 他人が、自分より僕に必要なものを分かってるつもりでいるのに、もううんざりです。

key: When you were gone, I already met Xerneas.
en: When you were gone, I already met Xerneas.
ja: あなたがいなくなっていた間に、僕はもうゼルネアスに会っていました。

key: We understand each other.
en: We understand each other.
ja: 僕たちは、お互いを理解しています。

key: We were still understanding each other when I was torn out.
en: We were still understanding each other when I was torn out.
ja: 引きはがされたときも、まだお互いを理解し合っている途中でした。

key: That was just part of it.
en: That was just part of it.
ja: それも、その一部にすぎません。

key: ...But you usually try to catch Legendaries.
en: ...But you usually try to catch Legendaries.
ja: ……でも、あなたはいつも伝説のポケモンを捕まえようとしますよね。

key: Okay, Xerneas will go with you.
en: Okay, Xerneas will go with you.
ja: 分かりました、ゼルネアスがあなたと一緒に行きます。

key: It's my friend, so take good care of it.
en: It's my friend, so take good care of it.
ja: 僕の友達なので、大事にしてあげてください。

key: NOEL: There's still more to do, right?
en: NOEL: There's still more to do, right?
ja: ノエル: まだやることがありますよね?

key: I'll wait for you.
en: I'll wait for you.
ja: 待っています。

key: RADOMUS: Ah--
en: RADOMUS: Ah--
ja: ラドマス: ああ――

key: The crest at last, is it?
en: The crest at last, is it?
ja: ついに紋章か。

key: That was an arduous climb... in no small part for the length of time I was left out on a limb.
en: That was an arduous climb... in no small part for the length of time I was left out on a limb.
ja: 実に骨の折れる登りだった……ずいぶん長く、危うい枝の上に取り残されていたせいも、少なからずあるが。

key: Literally, that is--
en: Literally, that is--
ja: 文字通りの意味でな――

key: I heard Noel was here and came to check on him, but in the end, those barriers nearly boxed me in entirely...
en: I heard Noel was here and came to check on him, but in the end, those barriers nearly boxed me in entirely...
ja: ノエルがここにいると聞いて様子を見に来たのだが、結局、あのバリアにほとんど閉じ込められかけてしまってな……

key: I suppose I have you to thank for it?
en: I suppose I have you to thank for it?
ja: それを助けてくれたのは、君に感謝すべきということかな?

key: I owe so much already, and now this too.
en: I owe so much already, and now this too.
ja: すでに多くの借りがあるというのに、これでまた一つ増えたわけだ。

key: But really, why must I always get stuck somewhere or other whenever I try to help out in any which way?
en: But really, why must I always get stuck somewhere or other whenever I try to help out in any which way?
ja: しかし本当に、どうにか力になろうとするたびに、いつもどこかしらで立ち往生する羽目になるのはなぜなのだろうな。

key: No matter. He is here, yes?
en: No matter. He is here, yes?
ja: まあいい。彼はここにいるのだろう?

key: RADOMUS: ...Ah.
en: RADOMUS: ...Ah.
ja: ラドマス: ……ああ。

key: RADOMUS: So, uh...
en: RADOMUS: So, uh...
ja: ラドマス: それで、その……

key: How's it going?
en: How's it going?
ja: 調子はどうだ?

key: NOEL: You can skip the half-hearted efforts.
en: NOEL: You can skip the half-hearted efforts.
ja: ノエル: 中途半端な気遣いは、飛ばしてもらって構いません。

key: RADOMUS: Of course, I can't say you're wrong to feel that way, but I assure you,
en: RADOMUS: Of course, I can't say you're wrong to feel that way, but I assure you,
ja: ラドマス: もちろん、そう感じるお前が間違っているとは言えぬが、しかし、これだけは言わせてくれ、

key: If my efforts are half-hearted, it's only because the other half went away a long time ago.
en: If my efforts are half-hearted, it's only because the other half went away a long time ago.
ja: もし私の気遣いが中途半端に見えるのなら、それはもう半分が、ずっと前に失われてしまったからにすぎない。

key: All that I have left is here for you.
en: All that I have left is here for you.
ja: 私に残された全てを、お前のためにここに差し出そう。

key: NOEL: ...I guess.
en: NOEL: ...I guess.
ja: ノエル: ……そうですか。

key: It seems like you only care about the half that's gone.
en: It seems like you only care about the half that's gone.
ja: 父さんは、失われた方の半分にしか、興味がないみたいですけど。

key: RADOMUS: I am ashamed to be all-too-often at a loss for how otherwise to show it, but I assure you, the distance between us is as great a tragedy as any other I've suffered.
en: RADOMUS: I am ashamed to be all-too-often at a loss for how otherwise to show it, but I assure you, the distance between us is as great a tragedy as any other I've suffered.
ja: ラドマス: それをどう示せばよいのか、あまりにしばしば分からなくなってしまうことを恥じているが、断言しよう、お前との間にあるこの隔たりは、私がこれまで味わってきたどの悲劇にも劣らぬものだ。

key: And, still being ongoing, perhaps even greater.
en: And, still being ongoing, perhaps even greater.
ja: しかも、それはいまだ続いているという点で、あるいはそれ以上とさえ言えるかもしれない。

key: NOEL: Sure.
en: NOEL: Sure.
ja: ノエル: はいはい。

key: You can say it, but it seems like you decided that Anna was the important one since the start.
en: You can say it, but it seems like you decided that Anna was the important one since the start.
ja: そう言うのは自由ですけど、父さんは最初から、アンナの方が大事だって決めてたみたいですし。

key: RADOMUS: I was worried about her.
en: RADOMUS: I was worried about her.
ja: ラドマス: あの子のことが、心配だったのだ。

key: I was afraid she would disappear like your mother.
en: I was afraid she would disappear like your mother.
ja: お前たちの母のように、消えてしまうのではないかと恐れていた。

key: And I was right.
en: And I was right.
ja: そして、その恐れは的中してしまった。

key: And it seems I was nearly right.
en: And it seems I was nearly right.
ja: そして、今回もほとんど的中しかけているようだ。

key: But even for all my worry, I wasn't able to prevent it.
en: But even for all my worry, I wasn't able to prevent it.
ja: だが、あれほど心配していたにもかかわらず、私にはそれを防ぐことができなかった。

key: All I did was make you feel like you were playing second fiddle.
en: All I did was make you feel like you were playing second fiddle.
ja: 私がしたことといえば、お前に、自分は二の次なのだと感じさせてしまっただけだ。

key: NOEL: It's not just that.
en: NOEL: It's not just that.
ja: ノエル: それだけじゃありません。

key: Even down to our names,
en: Even down to our names,
ja: 僕たちの名前からしてそうです、

key: Fantasia and Painter.
en: Fantasia and Painter.
ja: ファンタジアとペインター。

key: The amazing one, and the boring one.
en: The amazing one, and the boring one.
ja: すごい方と、つまらない方。

key: What will I do, go paint someone's house for them?
en: What will I do, go paint someone's house for them?
ja: 僕は何をすればいいんですか、誰かの家でも塗ればいいんですか?

key: You had a clear favorite since the start.
en: You had a clear favorite since the start.
ja: 父さんには、最初からはっきりお気に入りがいたんです。

key: RADOMUS: Ah.
en: RADOMUS: Ah.
ja: ラドマス: ああ。

key: I can understand your feeling that way, however...
en: I can understand your feeling that way, however...
ja: お前がそう感じるのも理解できる、しかし……

key: I'm afraid I must emphatically disagree.
en: I'm afraid I must emphatically disagree.
ja: 残念ながら、私はそれに強く異を唱えねばならない。

key: I worry that this will sound like mere excuses to you, but if you would believe it, I assure you that you and I see very different meanings in that name.
en: I worry that this will sound like mere excuses to you, but if you would believe it, I assure you that you and I see very different meanings in that name.
ja: これがただの言い訳のように聞こえてしまうのではと心配だが、信じてほしい、お前と私とでは、その名前に見出している意味がまるで違うのだ。

key: Where you see a laborer, I saw an artist.
en: Where you see a laborer, I saw an artist.
ja: お前は労働者を見ているのだろうが、私が見ていたのは芸術家だった。

key: These were fictions of the man I was more than a decade ago, but I had fancied the two of you inseparable and inconquerable.
en: These were fictions of the man I was more than a decade ago, but I had fancied the two of you inseparable and inconquerable.
ja: これは十年以上前の、あの頃の私が思い描いていた空想にすぎないが、私はお前たち二人を、切り離せず、征服されることもない存在だと思い描いていた。

key: Fantasia, the dreamer her mother was, and Painter, the one who could draw those dreams into reality.
en: Fantasia, the dreamer her mother was, and Painter, the one who could draw those dreams into reality.
ja: 母の姿そのままの夢見る者、ファンタジア、そして、その夢を現実に描き出せる者、ペインター。

key: NOEL: Her keeper.
en: NOEL: Her keeper.
ja: ノエル: 姉の、世話係。

key: RADOMUS: My present self laments the ideal.
en: RADOMUS: My present self laments the ideal.
ja: ラドマス: 今の私は、あの理想を悔いている。

key: It was immature of me not to imagine what worlds you would want to paint for yourself.
en: It was immature of me not to imagine what worlds you would want to paint for yourself.
ja: お前自身が、どんな世界を描きたいと思うか、それを想像しなかったのは、私の未熟さゆえだった。

key: And what is in a name?
en: And what is in a name?
ja: そもそも、名前に何の意味があるというのだろうな?

key: Whatever it is, it's certainly not who one must be.
en: Whatever it is, it's certainly not who one must be.
ja: それが何であれ、その人がどうあらねばならないかを決めるものでは、決してない。

key: Even then, I don't see it as so unenviable.
en: Even then, I don't see it as so unenviable.
ja: それでも、私はそれを、そこまで羨むに値しない立場だとは思っていない。

key: The world is full of dreamers.
en: The world is full of dreamers.
ja: 世界には、夢見る者があふれている。

key: Dreams are in high supply and no demand.
en: Dreams are in high supply and no demand.
ja: 夢は供給過多で、需要はない。

key: What is needed is the ability to bring them into life.
en: What is needed is the ability to bring them into life.
ja: 必要なのは、それを現実へと形にする力なのだ。

key: To some, perhaps even a black and white world like this one is a canvas waiting to be drawn on.
en: To some, perhaps even a black and white world like this one is a canvas waiting to be drawn on.
ja: 人によっては、この白黒の世界のようなものすら、描かれるのを待つキャンバスに見えるのかもしれない。

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: ……ああ。

key: I guess it was obvious.
en: I guess it was obvious.
ja: 分かりきったことだったのかもしれないな。

key: RADOMUS: Hm?
en: RADOMUS: Hm?
ja: ラドマス: うん?

key: NOEL: The color is gone.
en: NOEL: The color is gone.
ja: ノエル: 色が失われています。

key: It was taken away, so we just need to put new color back instead.
en: It was taken away, so we just need to put new color back instead.
ja: 奪われたのなら、代わりに新しい色を戻せばいいだけです。

key: RADOMUS: ...Of course.
en: RADOMUS: ...Of course.
ja: ラドマス: ……なるほど。

key: But at a place like this, how could we?
en: But at a place like this, how could we?
ja: だが、こんな場所で、一体どうやって?

key: NOEL: You were late.
en: NOEL: You were late.
ja: ノエル: 遅かったですね。

key: I met Xerneas.
en: I met Xerneas.
ja: 僕はもう、ゼルネアスに会いました。

key: RADOMUS: Indeed?
en: RADOMUS: Indeed?
ja: ラドマス: そうなのか?

key: NOEL: Xerneas understood me.
en: NOEL: Xerneas understood me.
ja: ノエル: ゼルネアスは、僕を理解してくれました。

key: RADOMUS: Perhaps I should talk with it...
en: RADOMUS: Perhaps I should talk with it...
ja: ラドマス: 私も、話をしてみるべきかもしれないな……

key: NOEL: And I understood Xerneas.
en: NOEL: And I understood Xerneas.
ja: ノエル: そして、僕もゼルネアスを理解しました。

key: NOEL: The way it shapes life and land...
en: NOEL: The way it shapes life and land...
ja: ノエル: 命や大地を形作るそのやり方は……

key: It's no different than art.
en: It's no different than art.
ja: 芸術と何ら変わりません。

key: Just creation.
en: Just creation.
ja: ただの創造です。

key: Trees should be green.
en: Trees should be green.
ja: 木は緑であるべきです。

key: The sky should be blue.
en: The sky should be blue.
ja: 空は青であるべきです。

key: What color should I be?
en: What color should I be?
ja: 僕は何色であるべきなんでしょう?

key: And what does it matter?
en: And what does it matter?
ja: そして、それに何の意味があるんでしょう?

key: No, let's make something completely different.
en: No, let's make something completely different.
ja: いえ、まったく違うものを作りましょう。

key: RADOMUS: Ah...
en: RADOMUS: Ah...
ja: ラドマス: ああ……

key: NOEL: I think I understand now.
en: NOEL: I think I understand now.
ja: ノエル: 今なら分かる気がします。

key: RADOMUS: ...Well, that would make one of us.
en: RADOMUS: ...Well, that would make one of us.
ja: ラドマス: ……なら、私たちのどちらか一人は分かった、ということだな。

key: NOEL: Oh well.
